fact: The Ministry's HMIS standard operating procedures of April 2020 state that peripheral health units (CHC, CHP, MCHP) compile monthly reports on paper HMIS summary forms and submit hard copies to the district health management team by the fifth day of the month, where the district M&E officer verifies them and a data entry officer keys them into DHIS2, while a hospital's own M&E officer enters hospital data into DHIS2; decentralising electronic entry to CHCs at chiefdom level is stated as a plan for 2020, not yet in effect.
title: Standard Operating Procedures for the Health Management Information System: Data Management Procedures Manual I
publisher: Government of Sierra Leone, Ministry of Health and Sanitation / MEASURE Evaluation
